Coverage_Description: 21/25-year participating savings protection plan with guaranteed annual cash coupon of 5% of sum assured from policy year 2, guaranteed maturity amount (total guaranteed payout 120
pricing: US$2,006/year (illustrative: age 25, non-smoker male, US$20,000 sum assured, 21-year term); US$1,834/year (same profile, 25-year term).
customer requirement: Insured issue age 18-35 (age next birthday); for disability benefit: Hong Kong ID holder and Hong Kong resident
price structure: Regular premium by selected term (21 or 25 years), USD-denominated, sum-assured based; volume discount per US$1,000 sum assured: 0.2/0.3/0.4/0.5 at sum assured ≥US$200k/300k/400k/500k
additional informations: Guaranteed insurability option (no medical evidence) to add cover up to 2x existing total sum assured (cap US$250,000) upon specified life e; optional riders (medical, accident, premium waiver); non-guaranteed reversionary and special bonuses declared from policy year 3
